svg.title: Large-ship traffic falls off step by step as each river or channel passes its ports

cc:Work.dc:title: Large-ship traffic falls off step by step as each river or channel passes its ports
cc:Work.dc:description: Fifteen small step charts, one per river or ship channel, each showing distinct large ships against distance from the entrance; every profile steps down past the ports along the way.
